name: MRC 0139-273 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant radio source MRC 0139-273, seen by Hubble.
label: mrc0139273-hubble
story: Hubble looked around MRC 0139-273, one of the most luminous radio sources in its slice of the distant universe, in a field found to be unusually crowded with galaxies. Crowds like this have the look of galaxy clusters still in the making.

claims.text: MRC 0139-273 is a powerful radio source at redshift 1.44, in a complete sample of the most luminous radio sources at 1.44 to 1.7
The sample is drawn from the Molonglo Reference Catalogue (MRC)
Its field is the richest of those imaged, with an excess of galaxies
Such overdensities look like forming clusters of galaxies
